subject: Can't accept Workday invite — link becomes .eml attachment in Exchange
messages:
From: Aarav Shah <aarav@solariscorp.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@solariscorp.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Oct 2025 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Can't accept Workday invite — link becomes .eml attachment in Exchange

Hi Lauren,

We're trying to onboard Solaris Components into your Workday supplier portal but when my colleague Emily and I click the 'Accept invite' link in the activation email the link is not opening. Instead Outlook/Exchange converts the whole message chunk into an attached .eml file (we see an attachment named accept-invite.eml) and clicking that attachment opens a preview rather than the Coupa/Workday flow.

We tried:
- Outlook desktop (Win10) — same behavior, link appears inside attached .eml
- Outlook web (OWA) — preview shows the .eml and the link is non-clickable
- Mobile (iOS Outlook app) — link opens the .eml viewer but not the portal flow

We need to accept the invite to claim the supplier account so we can receive PO 4521. Is there a way to send a claim code or an alternate link? Happy to attach the .eml if that helps (I can forward the raw .eml).

Thanks,
Aarav Shah
VP, Procurement
Solaris Components
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Oct 2025 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Can't accept Workday invite — link becomes .eml attachment in Exchange

Hi Aarav — thanks for the clear notes.

Quick checklist while we investigate:
- Please forward the original invite (the raw .eml) to me (invite.eml) and include the message headers if possible — that helps us see any transport rewrite rules.
- Can you confirm the sender address you saw on the invite (the From: in the email)?
- As a short-term workaround, try opening the .eml in Chrome (download "accept-invite.eml" and drag into a new Chrome tab) or try a different device/browser if available. Sometimes Outlook's preview strips the anchor.

If that doesn't work I'll ask David to generate a one-time claim code we can issue manually so you can finish the onboarding. I know you have a PO pending so we'll prioritize it.

If you can attach the .eml here I can pass it to our onboarding team.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Manager, Supplier Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Aarav — sorry for the friction. Two ways to get you unstuck quickly:
1) I can provision the Solaris vendor record manually from our admin console and mark it as claimed (one-off). That requires David or I to create the claim and then you to confirm identity.
2) Engineering/Onboarding can create a time-limited manual claim code (single use).

David — can you create a short-lived claim code (24h) for Solaris and put simple instructions in a text file (manual-claim-instructions.txt)? I'm putting this as high priority because there's an active PO.

Aarav — Ben here (Seller Success). If you prefer, I'll open a Coupa Support ticket on your behalf, but usually a manual claim code is fastest.

-ben
